defect: The new BlobFileCompletionCallback keeps private members sst_file_manager_, mutex_ and error_handler_ that are never used in ROCKSDB_LITE builds, so clang's -Wunused-private-field (with -Werror) breaks the LITE build on macOS.
reason: The class is new in this change and the fix only moves the LITE #ifdef so the unused fields disappear in LITE, repairing a compile failure caused by these exact lines.

defect: The added assert(!prefetch_index || prefetch_filter) states the implication backwards, so it fires (debug abort) when a two-level index is pinned/prefetched without a partitioned filter.
reason: The assert was added by this change and contradicts its own comment (partitioned filters require partitioned indexes); the fix just reverses the implication.

defect: The added make_shared<FaultInjectionSecondaryCache>(secondary_cache, FLAGS_seed, ...) passes the uint64 FLAGS_seed to a uint32_t constructor parameter, an implicit narrowing that MSVC (warnings as errors) rejects, breaking the Windows db_stress build.
reason: The narrowing call is in lines this change added and the fix only adds the static_cast<uint32_t>, which needs the flag type and constructor signature from other files to see.

defect: The change put #ifndef ROCKSDB_LITE / #endif preprocessor directives inside the string argument of the DEFINE_string(benchmarks, ...) macro call, which is undefined by the standard and fails to compile with MSVC.
reason: The directives were added by this change and the fix replaces them with the IF_ROCKSDB_LITE macro already used a few lines above for exactly this reason.

defect: The added RecordTick(stats_.get(), ...) calls read the stats_ shared_ptr without holding mu_ while SetStatisticsPtr (added in the same commit) writes it, a data race reported by TSAN.
reason: The unsynchronized reads are lines this change added and the fix moves them under mu_ (and locks the setter), but the racing writer lives in delete_scheduler.h and db_impl_open.cc.

defect: The new BloomFilterWrapper test compares the uint32_t GetCounter() result with signed int values (0, maxKey, 2 * maxKey) in ASSERT_EQ, a signed/unsigned comparison that breaks the -Werror build on macOS.
reason: The comparisons were added by this change and the fix only makes the expected values unsigned to repair the build failure.

defect: The added forward declaration 'class SuperVersion;' does not match the 'struct SuperVersion' definition, which clang rejects under -Werror,-Wmismatched-tags.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added line to 'struct SuperVersion;', and seeing the mismatch needs column_family.h.

defect: The new DBImpl::GetCreationTimeOfOldestFile iterates the column family set and calls cfd->current()->GetCreationTimeOfOldestFile() without holding the DB mutex or referencing the version, so a concurrent compaction can free the version (heap-use-after-free).
reason: The function is new in this change and the fix adds the missing SuperVersion reference and dropped-CF check that the unprotected access lacked.

defect: Replacing the leaked raw pointers with namespace-scope static std::unique_ptr comparators makes them subject to static initialization/destruction order: Options() built during other translation units' static init (e.g. db_stress flag defaults) calls BytewiseComparator() before or independently of comparator.cc's own static init/teardown, which segfaults db_stress on OS X.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these global unique_ptrs with function-local statics (the standard cure for init-order problems), and the static-init callers are only visible in other files such as tools/db_stress.cc.

defect: Enabling the static A cleanup helper on OS X (via pthread_getspecific(Instance()->pthread_key_)) makes its destructor run OnThreadExit on the already destroyed StaticMeta singleton at exit, a use-after-destruction that the change's own comment admits.
reason: The OS X path is new in this change (before it the helper did not compile there) and the fix removes the helper on OS X as part of the db_stress segfault fix.

defect: The new header includes "include/rocksdb/persistent_cache.h" instead of the project-wide "rocksdb/persistent_cache.h", which does not resolve (or double-includes) in the internal build and breaks it.
reason: The bad include path is in this newly added file and the fix changes only that line to the consistent path used everywhere else.

defect: The added assert(logs_.empty() || (logs_.size() == 1 && !logs_[0].getting_synced)) in MarkLogsSynced ignores logs newer than up_to created while SyncWAL had released the mutex, so it fires after concurrent log rolls.
reason: The assert is new in this change, and the loop above it (which stops at number > up_to) together with the unlocked SyncWAL shows such logs can exist; the fix relaxes exactly this assert.

defect: The added 'const int kWriteOutEveryBytes' is compared with the size_t batch.GetDataSize(), a signed/unsigned comparison that fails the -Werror=sign-compare build.
reason: The constant and comparison were added by this change and the fix only changes its type to size_t; the size_t return type is declared in write_batch.h.

defect: The added code declares char scratch[200] but calls compact->compaction->Summary(scratch, 256), allowing a 256-byte write into a 200-byte stack buffer (stack overflow, segfault).
reason: Both lines were added by this change, the mismatch is plain in the diff, and the fix sizes the buffer to 256 and passes sizeof(scratch).

defect: The new public header forward-declares 'class Options;' although Options is defined as a struct, which clang on Mac rejects under -Werror,-Wmismatched-tags.
reason: The header is new in this change and the fix changes only this declaration to 'struct Options;', but seeing the mismatch needs options.h.

defect: The rewritten createNewSliceFromString stores strlen(str) (size_t) into 'const int len', an implicit 64-to-32-bit narrowing that breaks the RocksJava build with clang on Mac OS X.
reason: The line was added by this change and the fix only changes len to size_t to repair the Mac build.

defect: The new Windows NoSpace mapping checks only ERROR_HANDLE_DISK_FULL and misses ERROR_DISK_FULL, the code WriteFile normally returns on a full disk, so disk-full errors on Windows still come back as plain IOError without the NoSpace subcode.
reason: The incomplete condition is in lines this change added for the NoSpace feature, and the fix extends exactly that condition with ERROR_DISK_FULL.

defect: The fix removes the timing-dependent ASSERT_EQ(CountFilesInDir(trash_dir_), 25) from the new ImmediateDeleteOn25PercDBSize test because it was flaky.
reason: This is a test-only change that removes a flaky assertion; no product code defect is repaired.

defect: The new static ReduceNumberOfLevels allocates files_ with only new_levels entries but, unlike the old member version, no longer lowers the VersionSet's num_levels_, so WriteSnapshot in LogAndApply reads past the end of the array and segfaults.
reason: The size mismatch comes from this change dropping the num_levels_ update while keeping the smaller array, and the fix allocates current_levels entries; seeing it needs WriteSnapshot and the removed version_set_reduce_num_levels.cc.

defect: The fix passes TableProperties as a raw pointer instead of copying a std::shared_ptr on every Get/NewIterator call, removing an atomic refcount cost (a performance issue, not a functional defect).
reason: The shared_ptr-by-value signature is correct and only costs time (the previous code already copied a std::string per call), so the fix is an efficiency change, not a repair of a wrong result, crash or similar defect.
